name: Aldith Bracken
source_profile:
Aldith Bracken (LN) — Ranger-Captain

Dame Aldith is a seasoned woodsman and former military scout who commands the Blackthorns with quiet efficiency. She is deeply loyal to Elowen Harrowmont and considers the marquessa's authority essential to the orderly development of Thornhollow. Though she prefers negotiation to bloodshed, Aldith has little patience for those who interfere with lawful timber operations, even when their grievances are legitimate.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 19 (source excerpt; may be partial)
